arrangement.description: Study 01 variation A keys with melodic answer A. The answer is not inside the keys file.

length_choice: Eight bars was chosen before the notes. Sixteen bars at 60 BPM is 64 seconds and sixteen bars at 90 BPM is 42.7 seconds, both outside 10 to 40 seconds. Eight bars at 72 BPM is 26.7 seconds. Every study uses that 8-bar container.
microtiming: Keys use a fixed roll. The highest voice has offset 0. Each lower voice is 20 ticks later, so three notes use 40, 20, and 0 from low to high, and the one four-note chord uses 60, 40, 20, and 0. performed_start = nominal_start + offset. Duration is measured from the performed start. The melodic answer offset is 0. Its pocket is in the written rhythm. Offsets are bounded and shared by voice position. They are not chosen independently for every note.
note_policy: Note-only MIDI. No program changes, controllers, pitch bend, aftertouch, or SysEx.
processing_not_in_file: Pitch instability, noise, saturation, and filtering are not in the MIDI files. The renderer does not apply them.
range_statement: Keys use MIDI 48 to 76, at most four notes at once. Notes below 60 are shown as the lower hand. Notes from 60 up are the upper hand. The melodic answer is monophonic, MIDI 60 to 81, a reference, and not part of the core count.
seed_meaning: Seeds identify studies. Nothing is random.
stack_warning: Use either the combined arrangement or the separate parts. Do not stack the part files on top of the combined file.

studies.accent: Contour 48, 52, 56, 60, 54, 58, 64, 70. The top voice is 8 higher. The answer stays quieter, between 44 and 52.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: One chord a bar: Em7, C, F, G7, E5, Am, Dm, C. The first chord is E G B D, with no C, so it is not a Cmaj7. The second is E G C, with no A, so it is not an Am7.
studies.identity: Variation A sits on beat 1. The first chord is four notes, then three. Bars 4 to 6 shorten, and bar 7 holds. Variation B starts on beat 2, uses a different inversion, and lasts one beat.
studies.layering: One keys track, split at C4 for display. The melodic answer is a separate monophonic reference.
studies.limitations: Pair keys A with answer A, and keys B with answer B. The answer is a reference file. It is not inside the keys file.
studies.title: Paper Window
studies.voicing: Close voicings from E3 to G4. The first chord is E3 G3 B3 D4, an Em7, not a Cmaj7. The top voice is the clearest tone. At most four notes sound.

studies.harmonic_rhythm: One chord a bar in variation A: Am, Dm, Bb, C, Bb5, A5, Gm, Fmaj7. The C chord is G C E and has no Bb, so it is not a C7. The Bb chord has no A, so it is not a Bbmaj7. The A chord has no C or G, so it is not an Am7.
studies.identity: Variation A enters on the and of 1 and holds for two beats, longer on the last bar. Variation B is on the downbeat and lasts a dotted eighth. Variation B does not put a seventh on top.
studies.layering: Keys carry the harmony. The answer is a reference and does not double the chord tones on the same attacks.
studies.limitations: The answer plays only four notes in A and two in B. Silence is the rest of the line.
studies.title: Late Shells
studies.voicing: Three-note shells. Variation A does not keep a seventh in every bar. Variation B does not put the seventh on top, and it changes the low note.

studies.accent: Contour 50, 50, 56, 56, 62, 62, 68, 68. Even bars match the fifths.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: Variation A: G, D, E5, C on even bars only. The E5 is E and B, a bare fifth, not Em. Variation B: G, D, Em, C, G, D, E5, C. The later E chord is E and B with no third, so it is not Em.
studies.identity: Variation A is two-note fifths on even bars, held almost the whole bar, with odd bars empty. Variation B is a three-note chord on beat 3 of every bar, one eighth long.
studies.layering: No left-hand pad under the fifths. The answer is two notes in A and four in B.
studies.limitations: Odd bars of keys A are intentional silence, not a missing file. The answer does not fill those bars in variation A.
studies.title: Open Fifths
studies.voicing: A is a bare fifth. B adds the third and moves the register, except the E and B shell, which stays a fifth and is not labeled Em.

studies.accent: Contour 44, 48, 52, 56, 50, 54, 60, 66. The leading-tone bar is step 60, not a spike.
departures: Variation A bar 7 beat 2, tick 24000, uses C#4 (61) as a leading tone. It is outside D natural minor and is flagged. Variation B stays on C natural. No other study flags a departure.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: F A E (third, fifth, and ninth of D, no seventh), Gm7, Bb, Am7, Dm, Gm, A (variation A only), Dm. The first chord is not a Dm9.
studies.identity: Variation A starts on beat 2 with a three-note minor color and one flagged C#4. Variation B starts on beat 4, two notes, shorter, and never leaves the minor collection.
studies.layering: The answer has no note in bar 7, the bar that sounds the C#4 at tick 24000. It does not harmonize that pitch.
studies.limitations: The C# is one chord tone in keys A. It is not a new key, and it is not in the answer.
studies.title: Minor Ninth
studies.voicing: The first chord of variation A is F3 A3 E4: third, fifth, and ninth of D. The seventh is not in that chord, so it is not a Dm9. The dominant bar is the flagged C#4. B is a two-note shell.

studies.accent: Contour 48, 52, 56, 60, 64, 60, 56, 68. It rises, eases, then settles.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: Asus4, E shell, D, B5, A, D, Em7 color, A.
studies.identity: Variation A arrives on beat 3 and lets the third in at bar 4. Variation B is a two-note shell on the downbeat. It states major thirds on D F# and on G B, so those two shells are not suspended.
studies.layering: The answer states E, C#, and A in variation A, and B, A, F# in variation B.
studies.limitations: C# in variation A is inside A mixolydian. It is not a departure. Variation B has no C#.
studies.title: Suspended Room
studies.voicing: A is three notes. B is two notes. The D F# shell and the G B shell state major thirds. The other B shells do not.

studies.accent: Contour 42, 46, 50, 54, 48, 52, 58, 64. The softest keys in the pack.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: Ebmaj7, Cm7, Abmaj7, Bb7, Eb, Cm, Ab, Eb.
studies.identity: Variation A sits low, on the and of 2, for under two beats. Variation B starts on beat 1 in a higher inversion and holds for most of the bar.
studies.layering: The answer in A is four long tones on even bars. B answers only twice.
studies.limitations: This is the slowest study, 8 bars at 60 BPM, 32 seconds. It is not a 16-bar file.
studies.title: Low Register
studies.voicing: A stays around Eb3 to G4. B opens the spacing and reaches C5.

studies.accent: Contour 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62, 64, 68. A steady step, not a house curve.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: Bb, Bb, Gm, Eb, Bb6, F, C, Bb. Variation B uses the same plan with fuller shells.
studies.identity: Variation A is two notes on beat 4, an eighth long. Variation B is three notes a 16th after the downbeat, held much longer, with a longer last bar.
studies.layering: The answer sits above the shell and does not start with it.
studies.limitations: Beat 4 in variation A leaves the rest of the bar empty on purpose.
studies.title: Two-Note Shell
studies.voicing: A is a two-note shell with no seventh. B adds the third tone and changes the low pitch.

studies.accent: Contour 46, 50, 54, 58, 52, 56, 62, 70. The last hold is the clearest, still under 80.
studies.harmonic_rhythm: Variation A states a short chord then a held color every bar: E, C#, B, G#, E, F#, E, E. Variation B holds E, A, F#, E for two bars each.
studies.identity: Variation A attacks twice in every bar: a short chord on beat 1 and a two-note hold on beat 3. Variation B is one chord every two bars, held for 7200 ticks. D# is in the collection and is not used.
studies.layering: The answer enters on the odd bars, where variation B is silent and variation A is between its two attacks.
studies.limitations: Variation B does not play on odd bars. That rest is written. Do not copy variation A into those bars.
studies.title: Cadence Hold
studies.voicing: A moves inner voices every bar. B is a wide shell an octave lower and stays put.
